scope: Extend the existing bounded observed DXF SUNSTUDY graph to separately admitted same-revision AC1024 and AC1032 input/output, retaining AC1027 and all existing CLASS, ownership, graph, text, mutation, resource and transaction gates. No DWG SUNSTUDY or native rendering claim.

authority.title: Autodesk SUNSTUDY DXF group-code reference
authority.use: Defines the sampled SUNSTUDY identity, owner/reactor, date/hour and scalar field group roles; it does not certify native scene evaluation or the generated drawing's complete interoperability.

sampled_external_conversion.method: Full local DXFs authored from scratch with ezdxf 1.4.5 and the same inserted SUNSTUDY tags and dictionary edges were converted by ODA File Converter 27.1.0 DXF to matching-version DWG and back to DXF, with audit=1. The raw tag audit verifies the sampled owner/reactor edges and SUNSTUDY field values before and after; no output .err files were produced.
sampled_external_conversion.limits: The input CLASS row has instance count/proxy 1/0; ODA writes 2/1 on return. These 16-CLASS full source files are not the one-CLASS adapter profile, and the current strict CLI fails their import with an existing destination preserved. The pair is evidence for the selected DXF tags/edges only, not input CLASS fidelity, native DWG SUNSTUDY, full-file output, or native lighting semantics. ODA converter lineage is the separately recorded local batch, not inferred by the tag inspector.

selected_source_output.method: Minimal locally authored one-CLASS source for each revision; explicit CLI whole-source observation; same-revision strict ASCII/Binary output. ASCII is independently scanned as group-code pairs and Binary by ezdxf 1.4.5's binary tag loader. The selected SUNSTUDY fields and dictionary/reactor edges match; a modified binary dictionary key is rejected by the inspector.

validation.adapter: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^dwg2dxf_sunstudy_dxf_graph' --output-on-failure: 3/3 passed. Each version exercises exact source/class and graph binding, ASCII/Binary output/readback, repeat import, source/target mismatch, all existing mutation and late-mutation refusals, preserved sentinel, and corrected same-facade retry.
validation.cli: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --sunstudy-observation-only: 42 route/refusal controls passed including both new versions, both encodings, repeat conversion and cross-version refusal/retry. The existing fast dwg2dxf_cli_contract CTest also passed.
validation.source_and_output: tools/audit_sunstudy_dxf_graph.py SHA256 4f001fa5acf2f6056dd3a6117db0d0954f3d64f6c37a776e9408f8ad73531cba supports author and author-oda with --version AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 and inspects ASCII or ezdxf-decoded Binary tags. Generate into new scratch paths; timestamps make full producer file hashes run-specific.
validation.addressSanitizer: ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R '^dwg2dxf_sunstudy_dxf_graph(_AC1024|_AC1032)?$' --output-on-failure: 3/3 passed after rebuilding the final adapter with AddressSanitizer.

limits: Only one source SUNSTUDY, one exact canonical CLASS row, bounded source observation, no 340–343 references or date range, and the previously proven dictionary/root profiles are admitted.
Target must match source revision. Other classes, graph shapes, cross-revision conversion, native producer breadth and rendering remain unqualified.
